answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 32887 Country: Pakistan Title: Some confustions are there, how we have to do qirat in farz, witr, nafal and sunnat after surat fateha in 2 rakat or in all 4 rakat? Question: Some confustions are there, how we have to do qirat in farz, witr, nafal and sunnat after surat fateha in 2 rakat or in all 4 rakat?? and when we offering prayer behind imam what is the way?? Answer ID: 32887 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1290/789/H=1432) Surah al-Fatiha shall not be recited behind Imam rather all the muqtadi will keep quite. So is proved from the Hadith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
